narr: Thunderstorms produced localized flash flooding in Crockett County.
ev: Law enforcement reported 3 feet of water on the road, which resulted in two cars stalling out. Also, law enforcement reported a semi-trailer truck had water up to the radiator.
lsr: LAW ENFORCEMENT REPORTED 3 FEET OF WATER ON THE ROADWAY, WHICH RESULTED IN TWO CARS STALLING ON THE HIGHWAY. ONE OF THE VEHICLES WAS AN 18 WHEELER, WHICH HAD WATER HALF WAY UP THE RADIATOR.
